title: Encoded PowerShell execution on WORKSTATION6 by pgustavo - likely compromise
summary: User pgustavo (normally on WORKSTATION5) launched an encoded PowerShell command via wmiprvse.exe that disabled Script Block Logging and AMSI, downloaded malware from external IP 10.10.10.5 (not in company ranges), and executed downloaded code. The use of -enc flag, security control bypass, and unusual host all indicate active compromise.
evidence: Encoded PowerShell command (-enc flag) launched by wmiprvse.exe as pgustavo on WORKSTATION6
Decoded command disables Script Block Logging and bypasses AMSI security controls
Command downloads from IP 10.10.10.5 which is private but NOT in company's known network ranges
User pgustavo normally operates from WORKSTATION5, not WORKSTATION6 where alert occurred
Process chain: wmiprvse.exe (NETWORK SERVICE) → powershell.exe (pgustavo) → conhost.exe → whoami.exe
IP reputation: 10.10.10.5 rated suspicious as unknown external endpoint
related_to_prior: none yet - this is the first alert (ALERT-001)

recommended_actions.action: Reset credentials for user pgustavo and enforce MFA
Investigate wmiprvse.exe parent process origin from svchost.exe
Block IP 10.10.10.5 at perimeter and check for other connections
Full malware scan of WORKSTATION6 with updated definitions
Review pgustavo's recent login activity and file access across systems

title: Encoded PowerShell via WMI lateral movement on WORKSTATION6

The decoded command disables ScriptBlockLogging and AMSI, then contacts 10.10.10.5 to download and execute code. This follows the prior ALERT-001 encoded PowerShell event, indicating ongoing compromise.

title: PowerShell Beacon C2 Connection from Compromised Account
summary: User pgustavo launched an encoded PowerShell beacon from WORKSTATION6 (unusual host for this lab user) that connected to external IP 10.10.10.5:80. The decoded command disables script block logging and AMSI, downloads and runs code from the web—classic C2 beacon behavior. This is a continuation of the attack chain from ALERT-001/002 involving encoded PowerShell and WMI lateral movement.
evidence: powershell.exe launched with -enc flag from WmiPrvSE.exe parent process (WMI lateral movement)
